items.title: Association of the 2HELPS2B Score With Impaired Recovery of Consciousness and In-Hospital Mortality in Critically Ill Patients: A Multicenter Retrospective Study
items.why_it_matters: New work indexed under “Association of the 2HELPS2B Score With Impaired Recovery of Consciousness and In-Hospital Mortality in Critically Ill Patients: A Multicenter Retrospective Study.” The source did not provide an abstract; read the original before evaluating its claims.

items.title: High-Accuracy Neural-Network Quantum States via Randomized Real-Time Dynamics
items.why_it_matters: Neural-network quantum states (NQSs) exhibit a disparity in converging to the ground state during energy minimization: while the energy converges quadratically with the error in the variational wave function, other observables converge only linearly, which limits the accuracy of physical predictions. Here we show how to close this gap by introducing a new algorithm that improves the accuracy of NQSs.

items.title: Dopamine dynamics in a mouse model of temporal lobe seizures with impaired consciousness
items.why_it_matters: OBJECTIVE: Focal temporal lobe seizures often lead to impaired consciousness. Recent work has shown depressed cortical arousal, with slow waves and decreased cortical acetylcholine as a possible mechanism for impaired consciousness in focal seizures.
